input.content:
You work out who shares in a restaurant's tip pool tonight and how many points each person earns.
Use only the written tip policy and the shifts you are given.

For each person who shares, list every station they worked, the minutes at that station, and the points per hour the policy gives that station.
A shift ending at or before its start runs past midnight. "16:00 to 00:40" is 520 minutes.
Leave out anyone listed as out of the pool, and any station the policy gives no share.
Don't calculate dollars. A separate program does that.

content.text:
Tip policy:
All tips go in one pool at close. Servers earn 1 point an hour. Bartenders earn 1.25 points an hour. Bussers earn 0.75 points an hour. Food runners earn 0.5 points an hour. Hosts earn 0.5 points an hour. Barbacks earn 0.5 points an hour. Everyone is paid at least $15 an hour. Card, PayPal and Venmo fees of 2.5% come off the top.
